metrics.name: Cloud revenue growth, year on year

sections.thesis:
Why I own it: A fictional online retailer whose cloud and advertising units earn most of the profit.

What has to go right: Cloud growth re-accelerates, and retail margins keep widening as delivery costs fall.
sections.what_would_break_it:
• A daily close below 160 (level inv-160).
  • Cloud growth under 12% for two quarters.
